edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the untrusted caller becomes the privileged owner.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before promoting the pending owner.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
msg.sender indexes balances as the debited account in transfer.
msg.sender is the owner key of allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
msg.sender is the spender key of allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
msg.sender keys allowed and is forwarded as the from argument of receiveApproval.
msg.sender is passed into the external receiveApproval call, exposing the caller identity to the callback.
owner is the recipient of the foreign tokens transferred in transferAnyERC20Token.
newOwner is compared against msg.sender and then promoted to owner in acceptOwnership.
The constructor writes the initial _totalSupply.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to subtract burned balances.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes balances for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for from and to.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
Constructor initializes symbol = 'LFC'.
Constructor initializes name = 'LIFECOIN Token'.
Constructor initializes decimals = 18.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed initial supply.
Constructor mints the whole supply into balances of the fixed deployment address.
transfer debits the sender balance through safeSub.
transfer credits the recipient balance through safeAdd.
transferFrom debits balances[from] and the caller allowance through safeSub.
transferFrom credits the recipient balance through safeAdd.
approveAndCall performs the external receiveApproval call on the attacker-supplied spender contract.
The external spender contract can reenter the token contract while approveAndCall is still executing.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes the transfer function of an arbitrary tokenAddress contract.
The external token contract returns into transferAnyERC20Token, which trusts the returned boolean.
Owned constructor writes owner from msg.sender.
transferOwnership writes the staged address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner and clears newOwner.
Operand 'a' is consumed by the addition c = a + b.
Operand 'b' is consumed by the addition c = a + b.
The sum is stored in the local result 'c' of safeAdd.
Operand 'a' is consumed by the subtraction c = a - b.
Operand 'b' is consumed by the subtraction c = a - b.
The difference is stored in the local result 'c' of safeSub.
Operand 'a' is consumed by the multiplication c = a * b.
Operand 'b' is consumed by the multiplication c = a * b.
The product is stored in the local result 'c' of safeMul.
Numerator 'a' flows into the division in safeDiv.
Denominator 'b' flows into the division in safeDiv.
Quotient is returned through the local result 'c' of safeDiv.
The _newOwner argument flows into the newOwner state assignment.
_newOwner is written directly into the newOwner state variable.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The named return 'balance' carries balances[tokenOwner] back to the caller.
The 'to' argument is the recipient key credited in transfer.
The 'tokens' argument is the amount moved by transfer.
tokens is the subtrahend passed into safeSub for the sender balance.
tokens is the addend passed into safeAdd for the recipient balance.
The success flag is the boolean returned by transfer.
spender is the second key of allowed in approve.
tokens is the allowance value stored by approve.
The success flag is the boolean returned by approve.
The 'from' argument is the debited balance key in transferFrom.
The 'to' argument is the credited balance key in transferFrom.
The 'tokens' argument is the amount moved by transferFrom.
tokens is subtracted from balances[from] and the allowance via safeSub.
tokens is added to balances[to] via safeAdd.
The success flag is the boolean returned by transferFrom.
tokenOwner is the first key of allowed in allowance.
spender is the second key of allowed in allowance.
The named return 'remaining' carries the allowance value back to the caller.
spender is both the allowance key and the external contract that receives control in approveAndCall.
The spender parameter determines which untrusted contract is invoked by receiveApproval.
tokens is stored as allowance and forwarded to receiveApproval.
The opaque data payload is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Attacker-controlled data is passed verbatim into the external callback invocation.
The success flag is the boolean returned by approveAndCall.
tokenAddress selects the external contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token.
tokenAddress is the callee of the ERC20 transfer performed for the owner.
tokens is the amount forwarded to the foreign ERC20 transfer.
The success flag is the boolean returned by transferAnyERC20Token.
